title: TheySix and Sparked Host GTA VI giveaway
summary: TheySix partnered with Sparked Host on a giveaway for U.S. residents aged 18 and over. Entries closed on November 19, 2026.

body.text: Prizes included a digital copy of GTA VI for PS5 or Xbox Series X|S, or web hosting credit. Thanks to Sparked Host for supporting the TheySix community.
